definitions.gloss: famous song; musical masterpiece; classic piece of music
definitions.explanation: A well-known and highly regarded piece of music, whether classical, pop, folk, or any other genre. Implies widespread recognition and enduring popularity.

examples.japanese: ベートーベン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名曲|めいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}いた→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to a Beethoven masterpiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名曲|めいきょく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{愛|あい}されている→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: This song is still loved as a classic from the Showa era.

examples.japanese: {名曲|めいきょく}ぞろい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{一曲目|いっきょくめ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飽|あ}き→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聴|き}ける→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The album is full of great songs — you can listen from the first track to the last without getting bored.

notes:
USAGE:
Applies to all genres of music. Classical music fans, J-pop listeners, and karaoke enthusiasts all use this word. Part of the {名|めい}~ family of words that indicate excellence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名曲|めいきょく}ぞろい (full of great songs)
- {不朽|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名曲|めいきょく} (an immortal masterpiece)
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{名曲|めいきょく} (a hidden gem)
- {名曲|めいきょく}⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧ (a cafe that plays classical music)

RELATED {名|めい}~ WORDS:
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: masterpiece (literary, film, art)
- ⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧: famous painting or classic film
- ⟦{名言|めいげん}→名言：20185_meigen⟧: famous quote
